intro: This League Starter Build Tier List ranks our most powerful and popular builds with links to Build Guides. Path of Exile 2 has an incredible amount of build variety, generally every single Ascendancy is powerful if build correctly. While the team is working hard to create and cover all meta builds, some are still missing.

builds.summary: Maxroll 開荒 Build 評級 D 級。 不建議開荒，通常要等裝備成型。 The Poisonburst Arrow Acolyte of Chayula build obliterates monsters by causing an absolute ruckus of poison, bleed, and chaos explosions. Once the Acolyte of Chayula "awakens" from his dream, the build ramps further by becoming the Archon of Chayula , which is a buff that summons Chaos Tornadoes, and these create even more havoc.
